lines.text: David stays in Jerusalem while Joab besieges Rabbah, and David sends for Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, and sleeps with her.
Bathsheba sends word that she is pregnant, and Uriah sleeps at the door of the palace instead of going to his house.
Uriah refuses to go home because the ark and Israel are in tents, even after David gets him drunk in Hebron.
David writes a letter telling Joab to put Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle, and Uriah dies.
David tells the messenger to urge Joab to pull back from the city, and later Bathsheba bears David a son.

wrong_details.true: strengthen his attack against the city and demolish it
